Catalog & sources

113 standard HTML element types, counting each heading separately. 144 unique regular attribute names and 89 event handler names from the WHATWG HTML index.

Each example includes the parent, child, or related elements needed to explore it. Head metadata, templates, media, form submission, and window events have special conditions; their notes explain what this preview can demonstrate.

This catalog excludes obsolete elements and attributes, ARIA attributes, SVG and MathML element catalogs, and attributes defined solely by other specifications. Custom data-* attributes are explained as a family rather than counted as infinitely many names.

Standard entries can have experimental or incomplete browser implementations. The element badge detects a specialized browser interface; it is not a complete compatibility test. Attribute names cannot be reliably feature-tested just by setting them.

Examples run in an isolated frame. Navigation and form submission are intercepted; downloads, popups, and access to the parent page are unavailable. Edited scripts run only inside that frame. No changes are saved after a refresh.
